messages:
deploy-bot: Kickoff: staged rollout for service `inference-api` -> v2.3.5-canary at 5% (us-east & ap-south). Notes: tokenizer edge fix + KV prefetch optimization. Auto-rollback if p95 > 300ms or error-rate spike > 0.8% sustained 3m. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03/v2.3.5
jess: rolling. @marco can you run the canary-eval set and smoke checks?
marco: starting canary evals and synthetic probes now. sending to both regions.
priya: excluded eu and high-throughput tenants as usual. quiet window at 23:00 UTC so keep ramp conservative.
marco: 90s in: us-east looks clean p95 ~180ms, ap-south p95 jumped to 310ms, error 0.9% (mostly tokenization timeouts).
priya: ok looks like ap-south tail. tagging @infra. HOLD on any increases until infra confirms.
infra: investigating ap-south tokenizer logs. saw a surge of small requests causing serialization on GPU. may be a batching behavior difference in that region. not seeing related CPU thrash.
ops-bot: Suggestion: isolate ap-south by pinning traffic back to v2.3.4 for that region only while keeping us-east on canary. Command: `pin-version --service inference-api --region ap-south --version v2.3.4`
jess: +1 to isolate. we want to preserve momentum where healthy. votes: GO to isolate & continue us-east, HOLD to full rollback.
marco: I'll keep running extended evals in us-east for 10m. ap-south roll back if infra confirms.
priya: HOLD on global ramp. prefer partial rollback for ap-south.
infra: confirmed batching behavior in ap-south is suboptimal with current kernel selection. mitigation options: temporary patch to batching policy or roll ap-south back. patch would take ~25m to push.
jess: prefer fastest path -> partial rollback ap-south. Marco can you run `deploy rollback inference-api --to v2.3.4 --regions ap-south`? include canary guard.
marco: executing partial rollback now. staging the rollback in zones to avoid thundering herd.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollback: inference-api ap-south -> v2.3.4. Will step down traffic over 2 minutes per zone. Audit: https://deploys/release/1717009999/rollback
marco: rollback complete. ap-south back to v2.3.4. Observability: https://dashboards/release/1717009999/ap-south
infra: post-rollback metrics in ap-south: p95 back to ~190ms, errors down to 0.1%. kernel selection fallback applied implicitly.
jess: good outcome. keep us-east canary at 5% and watch for 20m. we'll evaluate batching fix for a later patch.
priya: updating release notes: append "NOTE: ap-south rolled back due to region-specific batching regression; will include batching policy patch in v2.3.6".
ops-bot: pin recorded: `pin-version --service inference-api --region ap-south --version v2.3.4` (audit id 55432).
jess: logging this thread for postmortem and release timeline. reconvene in 20m or earlier if alerts. :coffee:
